data.one_liner: High-performance data grid widget for large numeric tables with frozen headers
data.what_it_does: Provides a grid widget that efficiently renders large numeric data sets, supports frozen header rows and columns, and offers auto-fit width columns. It includes callbacks for row taps and long presses.
use_when: You need to display large numeric tables efficiently
You require frozen header rows or columns for better UX
You want a lightweight, declarative grid without external code generation
avoid_when: You need advanced sorting, filtering or pagination features
You are working on a very small data set where performance is not a concern
You require extensive customization beyond the provided API
strengths: Optimized layout algorithm for large data
weaknesses: Package is in early development; breaking changes may occur
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec and run flutter pub get
